target_meaning.depth: current sensor camera axial depth in mm, tactile/{side}_gsmini/depth, [240,320]

loss: L_depth + L_marker + 0.5 * L_delta_marker in train-statistic normalized coordinates
normalization: fixed train-only mean/std; statistics frame stride 10; all pixels/markers and both sensors
initialization: strict canonical Spatial V2 encoder checkpoint supplied by --spatial-init with --spatial-source-commit
checkpoint_selection: minimum full validation P0 loss after each epoch
